purpose: Teach: 開通/見出す/最優秀/難易/パケット/初版/定数/休止

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、駅前道路の開通を喜ばれた
lines.en: When Dad was founding the company, he was delighted when that road in front of the station opened.
lines.style: Gentle, reminiscent opening. Warm, measured pace. Speaking from a place of accumulated memory. Soft authority—the elder recalling something he witnessed and valued.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の長所を見出すのが得意だった
lines.en: Yes. Dad had a gift for recognizing the strengths in his people.
lines.style: Respectful affirmation. Clear, steady delivery on the key phrase. Not rushing—honoring what's being said. Composed but warm underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、最優秀社員に自ら手紙を書かれた
lines.en: He would write letters to his best employees with his own hand.
lines.style: Quiet admiration in the voice. Slight emphasis on 'own hand'—the weight of that personal gesture. Slower pace, as if seeing the memory clearly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは難易度の高い交渉に自ら臨まれた
lines.en: Yes. He would even take on the most difficult negotiations himself.
lines.style: Steady reflection. A note of respect on 'difficult'—acknowledging the courage that required. Measured, not ceremonial. Eyes looking back, not down.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、初期のパケット通信を導入された
lines.en: He was one of the first to adopt packet communications for the business.
lines.style: Slight lift of pride on the opening. Speaking to foresight, not just memory. Deliberate pace. The satisfaction of remembering something ahead of its time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは初版書籍を大切に保管された
lines.en: Yes. He kept the very first edition of our company book. Treasured it.
lines.style: Quiet warmth. Slight linger on 'treasured'—the tenderness of that care. Not dramatic. Just stating a fact that carries weight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、定数的な品質を維持された
lines.en: He maintained the same exacting standard in everything we did.
lines.style: Firm respect. Light emphasis on 'exacting'—not harsh, just precise. The satisfaction of continuity. Steady, grounded delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは事業休止の判断も的確だった
lines.en: Yes. And when it came time to pause operations, his judgment was exactly right.
lines.style: Finality with grace. Slight pause before 'exactly right'—the weight of that difficult decision. Composed close. Not sad, but clear. The wisdom of knowing when to let something rest.
